source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("e-government" OR "e-governance" OR "electronic government") AND (municipal OR city OR "local government" OR urban)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("e-government" OR "e-governance" OR "electronic government") AND (municipal OR city OR "local government" OR urban),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("electronic government" OR "e-governance" OR "e-government") AND ("local government" OR "city" OR "municipal" OR "urban"))
